name: com.finditdifferently/tours
title: Find It Differently
description: Private tours in Copenhagen and Denmark, max 6 guests: list tours, details, booking links.

tools.name: list_tours
tools.description: List Find It Differently private tours in Copenhagen and Denmark. Every tour is private, max 6 guests. Optional filters: free-text query, category, maximum price per group in EUR, maximum duration in minutes.

query.description: Words to match in name, description or category, e.g. "food", "castle", "e-bike".

max_price.description: Maximum "from" price per group in EUR.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: Full details of one tour: description, price per group, duration, group size, tour page and booking link.

tour.description: Tour id, slug or exact name from list_tours.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Checks whether a group size fits a tour and the date is valid, and returns the link where live availability and the final price are shown. This server does not hold the live calendar: availability is confirmed only at booking_url.

tour.description: Tour id, slug or exact name.

guests.description: Number of guests in the private group (1-6).
